newsitem.title: USA: German fighter jet crashes in New Mexico.
newsitem.headline: German fighter jet crashes in New Mexico.

text.p: A German Air Force Tornado fighter jet crashed on a training flight at White Sands Missile Range in southeast New Mexico on Tuesday and both crewmen ejected safely, Air Force officials said.
The Tornado was on a routine training mission out of Holloman Air Force Base, 165 miles (265 km) southeast of Albuquerque, Sgt. Tom Mullican said.
Both pilots were taken to the base's hospital where they were being treated, Mullican said.
He said there was no report of any damage or injuries on the ground and that Air Force investigators were investigating the cause of the crash.
The two pilots are members of a German air force tactical training wing stationed at Holloman. The pilots were not immediately identified.
